items.title: Dave Bennett interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, April 16, 2025
items.q: I went to New York with my then-road manager, Hugh Lehl

ctx.x: And are you aware of Sol Yaged?

Yes. You know I got to meet Sol a few times. So back in 2010 I went to New York with my then-road manager, Hugh Lehl, he was a guy from Windsor. He used to put on jazz concerts. And he brought in guys like Bucky and Peter and Mundell Lowe, and so I got to meet these guys through him. So we went to New York just to visit and hang out, and I got to sit in with Sol where he was playing. So we spent an evening playing together.
